name: Chat history
summary: The everyday case: four conversations under a counted heading, with Search and Select in the nav. The pill that used to sit at the foot of the list is gone.

looseEnds.title: The memory count no longer renders anywhere
looseEnds.detail: Three of the twelve rows across these frames still carry a Metadata frame holding a bullet and the words '3 memories created'. Both are switched off, and the other nine rows do not carry the frame at all — so no row reports what a conversation contributed. This is the one place in the product that reported it, and the copy also changed from 'N memories saved' to a hardcoded '3 memories created'.
looseEnds.ask: Is the memory count dropped for launch, or switched off by hand? If it is staying, it needs a rule for the number and for rows that produced none.

looseEnds.title: Rows come in two shapes on the same list
looseEnds.detail: Row 2 holds a Metadata frame; rows 1, 3 and 4 hold a bare timestamp text node. They render identically, so a developer reading the layer tree sees a structural difference that carries no meaning.
looseEnds.ask: Flatten the rows to one shape, or keep the Metadata frame on all four.

looseEnds.title: The pill group sits 4px further left here than on the same nav elsewhere
looseEnds.detail: Search and Select are the same two components throughout, but the group that holds them is 275 wide with an 8px gap on the History frames and 271 wide with a 4px gap on the Deleting frames and on Memory. Both end flush at x=369, so the difference shows up on the left edge.
looseEnds.ask: Pick one gap. 4px matches Memory, which a developer will build from the same component.

constraints.label: Conversation title
constraints.summary: One line, 285px wide, truncated with an ellipsis. Narrows to 245px the moment selection turns on, so the same conversation cuts in two different places.

steps.label: SF Pro Text Regular 15px, average advance
